query.text: select stt_rec_tt, sum(tt_qd) as tt_qd into #v from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec group by stt_rec_tt select @@fieldExternal from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmtk b on a.tk_co = b.tk left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh_i = c.ma_kh &ESG.queryLoadingHoverField; left join cttt20 d on a.stt_rec_tt = d.stt_rec left join m41$$partition$current e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join #v f on a.stt_rec_tt = f.stt_rec_tt &ESG.queryLoading; where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec order by a.line_nbr

&CheckRelativeDeclare; select @$relController = 'CRInvoiceLookup', @$relType = 'Lookup', @$relParent = '' &CheckRelativeCall; declare @unitCode varchar(32), @voucherNumber varchar(32), @payID varchar(32) select @unitCode = case when @$ma_dvcs = '' then @@unit else @$ma_dvcs end, @voucherNumber = dbo.ff_PadL(@so_hd, col_length('cttt20', 'so_ct')) if exists(select 1 from cttt20 where ma_dvcs = @unitCode and ma_kh = @$ma_kh and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and stt_rec = @stt_rec_tt and so_ct = @voucherNumber) select @payID = @stt_rec_tt else select top 1 @payID = stt_rec from cttt20 where ma_dvcs = @unitCode and ma_kh = @$ma_kh and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and (tat_toan = 0 or (stt_rec in (select stt_rec_tt from cttt20 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and loai_tt = 1))) and so_ct = @voucherNumber order by stt_rec if @payID is not null begin declare @c numeric(28, 6) select @c = sum(tt_qd) from cttt20 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and stt_rec_tt = @payID select rtrim(a.tk) as tk, b.ten_tk%l as ten_tk, a.ngay_ct, case when isnull(a.ma_nt, '') = '' then (select val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0') else a.ma_nt end as ma_nt, a.ty_gia, case when a.ma_nt = '' then a.t_tt else a.t_tt_nt end as tien_hd_nt, a.t_tt_qd - isnull(@c, 0) as da_tt_nt, case when a.ma_nt = '' then a.t_tt else a.t_tt_nt end - (a.t_tt_qd - isnull(@c, 0)) as cl_nt, rtrim(ma_vv) as ma_vv, rtrim(ma_bp) as ma_bp, rtrim(so_lsx) as so_lsx, rtrim(ma_sp) as ma_sp, rtrim(ma_hd) as ma_hd, rtrim(ma_phi) as ma_phi, rtrim(ma_ku) as ma_ku from cttt20 a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.stt_rec = @payID return end
&CreateTicket; select @ticket as value return
declare @unitCode varchar(33) = case when @$ma_dvcs = '' then @@unit else @$ma_dvcs end select cast(case when exists(select 1 from dmtknh where ma_dvcs = @unitCode and tk = @tk_co) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as f4_yn
select row_number() over(order by line_nbr) as ln, *, tien - tong_da_tt as con_lai, tien - tong_da_tt as tien_cl, tien * 0 as tien_pb into #rs from zhopdongtt where ma_hd = @ma_hd
declare @ps_no0 numeric(28, 6) = @tien_nt IF @ps_no0 <> 0 BEGIN declare @tien_pb numeric(28, 6), @tien_cl numeric(28, 6), @tien_tt numeric(28, 6) SELECT @tien_pb = 0, @tien_cl = @ps_no0 create index ln on #rs(ln) UPDATE #rs SET @tien_pb = CASE WHEN @tien_cl = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN @tien_cl >= tien_cl THEN tien_cl ELSE @tien_cl END END, @tien_tt = CASE WHEN @tien_cl = 0 THEN tien_cl ELSE CASE WHEN @tien_cl >= tien_cl THEN 0 ELSE tien_cl - @tien_cl END END, @tien_cl = CASE WHEN @tien_cl = 0 THEN 0 ELSE @tien_cl - @tien_pb END, tien_pb = @tien_pb, tien_cl = @tien_tt from #rs with(index(ln)) END
if exists(select 1 from #rs) begin select '' as array$, ma_dot, tien, tong_da_tt, con_lai, tien_pb from #rs order by ln return end
&ESG.XMLGridResponse;
